look_here_first: Look at the leaf immediately: American holly is the big-leaved evergreen tree, with thick dark-green leaves bearing prominent stiff spine-tipped teeth.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: evergreen tree, often pyramidal when young

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaves substantially larger than yaupon leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: margins commonly armed with stiff spine-tipped teeth

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: upper surface dark glossy green; lower surface paler

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: female trees produce persistent bright-red drupes
